Summer Closure: Our offices will be closed from Friday, August 7th (2:00 PM) and will reopen on September 1st. For urgent matters, please send a WhatsApp to +34 661 687 465 or email us at the usual addresses.

Vacaciones de verano: Cerramos oficinas el viernes 7 de agosto a las 14:00 y reabrimos el 1 de septiembre. Para emergencias, envíe un WhatsApp al +34 661 687 465 o un correo a nuestras direcciones habituales.

English-Speaking Lawyers in Altea

Professional legal services for the international community in Altea, Albir and Sierra de Altea.

Bestill Time

Altea is widely regarded as the cultural capital of the Costa Blanca North. Its charming old town with whitewashed houses, thriving arts scene, and elegant marina attract a sophisticated international community — particularly from Scandinavia, the Netherlands, and Germany. Our multilingual team provides expert legal counsel for all aspects of life in Altea.

Altea Property Market: Scandinavian and Dutch Buyers Drive Premium Prices

Altea has consistently commanded premium property prices on the Costa Blanca North. Property in Altea old town sits at the upper end of the local market, and hillside villas with panoramic sea views in Sierra de Altea command a further premium.

Scandinavian buyers, particularly Norwegian and Swedish nationals, and Dutch buyers account for the majority of foreign purchases in Altea. The town's proximity to Alicante airport, excellent healthcare facilities, and its cultural offerings make it particularly attractive to retirees and remote workers.

Frequently Asked Questions — Lawyers in Altea

How much does a lawyer cost in Altea?

There are no hidden charges. For Altea matters we issue a written fixed quote after a free initial review, itemising our fees, taxes and the estimated notary and registry costs as a range.

Which legal matters do you handle in Altea?

In Altea we handle villa and high-value property conveyancing, planning and licence due diligence, Ley de Costas compliance, wealth tax, international estate planning, wills and non-resident taxation.

Do you speak English and other languages?

Yes. We work in Spanish, English, Dutch, French, German, Norwegian, Swedish, Polish and Russian, which is why most of our clients around Altea are international residents and non-resident owners.

Klar til å Diskutere Dine Juridiske Behov?

Vårt team er her for å hjelpe. Få en gratis innledende konsultasjon i dag.

Bestill Konsultasjon
Bufete Padilla. Engelsktalende advokater i Torrevieja, Moraira, Calpe, Altea og Costa Blanca siden 1976. Eiendomsrett, oppholdsvisum, immigrasjon, arv og NIE.
